1. **Free Shipping**: On all orders, every time.
2. **Bonus Freebies**: Sample-size coffee flavors and occasional discount codes on future machines.
3. **Simplified Purchasing**: No need to log in and check out individually for each item.
4. **Priority Access**: Early access to new product releases and limited-edition items.
